title: Creating an evidence-based illustration
purpose: Interpret a sampled source and write a caption that communicates evidence, selection and limits.
instructions: These terminal labels are plant orders, not species. Five flowering-plant orders and one represented gymnosperm outgroup are selected from the Kew release 4.0 order tree. Branch spacing is nonmetric.

pages.caption: Selected order records from Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew and collaborators, Tree of Life Explorer release 4.0; Baker et al. (2022). CC BY 4.0. Source bytes unchanged; selection and layout adapted for teaching.
questions: Identify the represented Asparagales/Poales and Fabales/Rosales groups by tracing their ancestors. What kind of records do these tip labels identify?
Does the drawing show all flowering-plant orders or all living plants? State one sampling limitation and one limit on interpreting branch lengths.
Write a short caption naming the source, the selected scope, one presentation modification, and the meaning of branch spacing.

relationshipDescription: Among the selected order records, Asparagales and Poales form a represented pair, as do Fabales and Rosales. Amborellales is another sampled flowering-plant order. Pinales represents a gymnosperm outgroup. Additional descendants are present in the complete source.
sourceLine: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew and collaborators. Tree of Life Explorer release 4.0 (2026), CC BY 4.0: creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Baker et al. (2022): 10.1093/sysbio/syab035. Activity text: 0BSD.
